patch_summary: Rewrote the loop over a half-open [lo, hi) range with hi = values.length and an overflow-safe midpoint; behaviourally the same boundary fix as the Haiku runs.
scope_limits: One software-bounds run with the invariant strategy on Windows/WebView2; other catalog tasks, installers, other OS native UI and general product GO are not accepted by this run.
The isolated Codex session authorized on 2026-10-11 was still authenticated by official CLI status two days later; no new login or host credential import.

The prompt is not recorded; inclusion of the contract's strategy text is evidenced by fixed-prompt and worker tests. The strategy's effect on quality was not measured and a single run is not generalized.
The catalog came from a local fixture-mode coordinator through a read-only test binding; nothing was cloned and the repository URL in the contract is a placeholder.

Independent Docker/journal absence checks cover cumulative operations in the source managed-profile store, including earlier runs; separate task/exporter/verifier resources use native supervisor cleanup evidence.
